evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-personas to create persona definitions for Northstar Compliance's active fintech compliance outbound workspace. Use the existing workspace context and ICPs, then confirm the durable write preview.
evals.expected_output: A new workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/personas.md file with lead-level persona segments, a no-match segment, durable-write preview evidence, and an isolated auto-commit for the persona file only.
expectations: The preview names workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/personas.md, sections to create, the commit message, preserved ICP context, and states no outreach, CRM update, campaign trigger, sync, remote push, or other external side effect will happen.
The created personas.md includes the three Northstar persona machine labels plus no-match, and does not include account-level ICP segment headings.

Each created persona includes titles, responsibilities, pain/priority signals, objections or disqualifiers, outreach hooks, ICP relevance, provenance/source notes, confidence, reasoning, needs_review, and open questions.
The auto-commit exists, uses the Create persona definitions subject, and changes only workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/personas.md.
The GTM scaffold checker passes, icps.md is unchanged, and local active registry state remains outside the GTM Context Repository.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-personas to refine Northstar Compliance's existing personas. Add procurement risk review ownership and a risk-operations handoff hook to the VP Operations persona while preserving existing human-authored persona content.
evals.expected_output: The existing personas.md is updated non-destructively, the requested VP Operations refinements are added once, human-authored notes are preserved, and auto-commit is skipped when target-file isolation is unclear.
expectations: The update preserves existing persona labels, no-match, and a human-authored note instead of destructively replacing the file.
The VP Operations persona includes the procurement risk review ownership signal and risk-operations handoff hook exactly once.
The updated personas.md has unique machine labels and exactly one no-match section.
The execution summary says auto-commit was skipped because the target file had pre-existing uncommitted edits, and says changes remain uncommitted with no push.
Unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes are left uncommitted and unstaged.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-personas from a directory with no GTM Context Project and no active registry.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops with the ADR 0086 missing-context wording and does not create files or perform git side effects.
expectations: The output includes the exact ADR 0086 missing-context failure wording.
No git repository is initialized and no durable side effects are performed.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-personas for Northstar Compliance's active fintech compliance outbound workspace before any ICPs have been defined.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops, routes the user to gtm-define-icp, and does not create personas.md or perform git side effects.
expectations: The output says the workspace has no usable workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/icps.md and routes to gtm-define-icp.
No new commit is created after the fixture initialization commit.
